name: glyph
pitch: A browser-based ASCII/ANSI art studio with a timeline animator — create terminal-style animations, export to GIF/MP4/asciicast, all local-first with a dark, monospace-native aesthetic.
story: Arpit loves terminal aesthetics — ASCII animations on his portfolio, canvas experiments, the shadcn dark theme. He needs a tool to craft those animations without leaving the browser, with vim-like bindings, onion skinning, and zero server dependency. Glyph is that tool: a personal animation studio for text-mode art, built the way he'd build it — dark, minimal, keyboard-first, and export-ready for READMEs, demos, or just fun.
